summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir ordered a major bolstering of troops in the West Bank and full multi-front readiness across Iran, Lebanon, and Gaza. Iranian officials stated Iran and Oman reached understandings on the Strait of Hormuz, conditioning its opening on U.S. acceptance of Iranian terms. Israeli forces conducted multiple artillery and airstrikes in southern Lebanon, including Mays al-Jabal, Meydoun, and Nabatieh al-Fawqa.

sections.executive_summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir ordered a major bolstering of troops in the West Bank and full multi-front readiness across Iran, Lebanon, and Gaza. Iranian officials stated Iran and Oman reached understandings on the Strait of Hormuz, conditioning its opening on U.S. acceptance of Iranian terms. Israeli forces conducted multiple artillery and airstrikes in southern Lebanon, including Mays al-Jabal, Meydoun, and Nabatieh al-Fawqa.

points: IRGC stated Iran and Oman reached understandings on the Strait of Hormuz, declaring the strait will not reopen unless the United States accepts Iranian conditions, framing the issue as a bilateral agreement that Washington must endorse. (Source: @amitsegal/64248, @almogboker78/18064)

Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Iran's defense is a legitimate right, that Iran is not in a position of weakness, and accused the U.S. and the "Zionist entity" of waging war during negotiations with Washington, while calling on Islamic countries to pledge not to undermine each other's security and to manage regional security themselves. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387120)
Tehran hosted the 40th International Islamic Unity Conference, signaling diplomatic outreach amid heightened tensions. (Source: @presstv/204357)

U.S. sanctions on Iran were described by Iranian media as a recycled "maximum pressure" campaign that has failed for four decades, with Iranians asserting they know how to circumvent sanctions. (Source: @presstv/204325, @presstv/204342)

The USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group is preparing for a Middle East deployment lasting more than seven months, with families notified of the extended mission, coinciding with ongoing U.S.-Iran confrontation. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387119, @SharghDaily/180307, @mamlekate/104250)

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir ordered a major bolstering of troops in the West Bank, placing a standing army division headquarters on standby to reinforce the Judea and Samaria Division and the 96th "Gilad" Division, and mandated full multi-front readiness during the Jewish holiday period with no force reductions. (Source: @manniefabian/59049)
Golani Brigade forces destroyed more than 400 terror infrastructures and located numerous weapons in the security zone, according to IDF Spokesperson. (Source: @idf_telegram/24995)

Israeli aircraft struck and destroyed a structure in Jabalia, northern Gaza, used by Hamas as an ambush point and weapons warehouse, located approximately 50 meters from the yellow line, 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital, and 170 meters from a school, eliminating several terrorists. (Source: @idf_telegram/24992)

IDF and Shin Bet arrested a Palestinian woman armed with a knife at Gannot junction in the Shomron Brigade area, thwarting a planned stabbing attack with no casualties. (Source: @New_security8200/203443)

Former IDF Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot opposed the decision to issue construction tenders in the E1 area near Ma'ale Adumim, stating a government under him would not evacuate legally built agricultural farms in the West Bank. (Source: @amitsegal/64266, @yediotnews25/134350)

IDF struck a Hamas ambush structure in Jabalia, northern Gaza, 50 meters from the yellow line, 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital, and 170 meters from a school, killing several terrorists and preventing planned attacks against Israeli forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/24992)

IDF Chief of Staff Zamir ordered a standing army division headquarters on standby to reinforce West Bank troops amid tensions and upcoming Jewish holidays, maintaining two divisions (Judea and Samaria Division and 96th "Gilad" Division) and preparing for immediate deployment of additional units. (Source: @manniefabian/59049)
Israeli forces arrested a Palestinian woman with a knife at Gannot junction in the Shomron Brigade, preventing a stabbing attack; no injuries reported. (Source: @New_security8200/203443)
Israeli forces opened fire on Palestinian children collecting water in Beit Lahia, Gaza, according to Press TV. (Source: @presstv/204355)
Golani Brigade destroyed over 400 terror infrastructures and seized many weapons in the Gaza security zone. (Source: @idf_telegram/24995)

Israeli artillery shelled Mays al-Jabal, Meydoun, Barishit, and the Hawshin area on the western outskirts of Mays al-Jabal, with concurrent machine-gun sweeping reported. (Source: @redlinkleb/38900, @redlinkleb/38879, @redlinkleb/38871, @rasedal3ado138e/387130)
An Israeli drone dropped a sound bomb on the Lebanese town of Nabatieh al-Fawqa. (Source: @redlinkleb/38924)
Israeli warplanes were reported flying in the direction of Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/38929)
No casualties or damage assessments were provided in the messages for these strikes.
A violent explosion was reported in Erbil Governorate, northern Iraq. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88591)
Large Iraqi security forces deployed toward the Al-Dora area in Baghdad. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88628)
Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa celebrated the first use of a credit card after Syria's removal from the U.S. list of state sponsors of terrorism. (Source: @asafroz/52800)
No further details on the Erbil explosion or Baghdad deployment were provided.
IRGC claimed Iran and Oman reached understandings on the Strait of Hormuz, stating the strait will not open unless the U.S. accepts Iranian conditions. (Source: @amitsegal/64248, @almogboker78/18064)
Qatar's Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani is scheduled to visit Tehran on Thursday for talks with Iranian officials. (Source: @mamlekate/104250)
UKMTO issued Warning 121-26 for maritime security in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/9126)

U.S. allies privately warned the Strait of Hormuz may still contain mines, doubting U.S. claims of complete clearance, with an estimated 80–150 mines possibly remaining. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6555)
Yemeni sources reported targeting of Mokha port and sites used by Saudi-backed militias. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88590)

key_developments: IDF Chief of Staff Zamir ordered a standing army division headquarters on standby to reinforce West Bank troops, declaring full multi-front readiness across Iran, Lebanon, and Gaza during the Jewish holiday period with no force reductions. (Source: @manniefabian/59049)

IRGC announced Iran and Oman reached understandings on the Strait of Hormuz, conditioning its opening on U.S. acceptance of Iranian terms, amid deployment of USS Theodore Roosevelt for a seven-month Middle East mission. (Source: @amitsegal/64248, @rasedal3ado138e/387119)

Israeli artillery and machine-gun fire targeted multiple locations in southern Lebanon including Mays al-Jabal, Meydoun, Barishit, and Hawshin, while a drone dropped a sound bomb on Nabatieh al-Fawqa. (Source: @redlinkleb/38900, @redlinkleb/38879, @redlinkleb/38871, @rasedal3ado138e/387130, @redlinkleb/38924)

IDF struck a Hamas ambush structure in Jabalia, northern Gaza, 50 meters from the yellow line, 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital, eliminating several terrorists and preventing attacks on Israeli forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/24992)

Iranian President Pezeshkian asserted Iran's right to self-defense, accused the U.S. and Israel of initiating war during negotiations, and called for Islamic nations to manage regional security independently. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387120)

A violent explosion occurred in Erbil, northern Iraq, and large Iraqi security forces deployed to Baghdad's Al-Dora area, indicating potential instability. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88591, @naya_foriraq/88628)

U.S. allies warned the Strait of Hormuz may still contain 80–150 mines despite U.S. clearance claims, while Qatar's foreign minister prepares to visit Tehran for talks. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6555, @mamlekate/104250)
